name: agentic-tests
description: Agentic E2E test campaigns for web apps, HTTP APIs, MCP servers and mobile apps: the run skill drives fresh Codex subagents for authoring, planning, plan audit, execution, blind evidence review and repair over a bundled engine, and ends with an HTML report.

interface.shortDescription: Agentic E2E test campaigns with blind evidence review
interface.longDescription: Run an end-to-end test campaign against a web app (ego-browser), an HTTP API (curl, OpenAPI), an MCP server (mcpc) or a mobile app (Maestro). Every role is a fresh subagent: scenario authors, an environment operator, a planner and plan auditor, executors that save evidence, and verifiers that judge that evidence blind. The engine keeps the records, and the run ends with an HTML report; the campaign track also diagnoses, files and fixes product defects.
